title: Toolcraft - Starter kit for AI design apps
excerpt: Toolcraft is an open-source starter kit and UI library for building custom design apps with AI.
content_html:
Toolcraft is an open-source starter kit and UI library for building custom design apps with AI .

Use it to create small creative products, internal utilities, interactive experiments, and tools tailored to your workflow.

npx @pixel-point/toolcraft create

Apps gallery

Design the outcome.
Not the workspace.

Toolcraft gives AI an application architecture, not just components. It includes a working canvas, toolbar, layer system, timeline, and keyframe workflows, plus embedded AI skills, performance instructions, and visual testing rules to improve the quality and consistency of generated creative apps.

Works with Codex, Claude,
Cursor or any other AI agent.

Components for every creative workflow.

From sliders and panels to timelines, layers, and toolbars, everything you need to shape visual tools is already in place.

Design without limits

npx @pixel-point/toolcraft create

content_html_zh:
Toolcraft 是一个开源入门套件和 UI 库，用于使用 AI 构建自定义设计应用程序。

使用它来创建小型创意产品、内部实用程序、交互式实验以及适合您的工作流程的工具。

npx @pixel-point/toolcraft 创建

Apps gallery

设计结果，而不是工作空间。

Toolcraft 为 AI 提供了应用程序架构，而不仅仅是组件。 它包括工作画布、工具栏、图层系统、时间线和关键帧工作流程，以及嵌入式 AI 技能、性能说明和视觉测试规则，以提高生成的创意应用程序的质量和一致性。

可与 Codex、Claude、Cursor 或任何其他 AI 代理配合使用。

适用于每个创意工作流程的组件。

从滑块和面板到时间线、图层和工具栏，塑造可视化工具所需的一切都已经就位。

设计无极限

npx @pixel-point/toolcraft 创建
